tours.title: Tours
tours.description: Every tour, past, running and future. The state is read off the dates.
tours.readyProblems: Before it can be marked ready, it still needs:

delete.title: Delete this tour?
delete.description: Only a tour without reports is deleted: one with reports is hidden. This cannot be undone.

fields.title: Title
fields.showPreview: Visible to the public before the release, as a preview
fields.hubRotationOrder: Order of the rotations (hub tours only)
fields.reportWindowDays: Days to report a flight (empty: the division's)
fields.dailyLegLimit: Legs per day on this tour (empty: no limit of the tour)
fields.requiresProcedures: SID, STAR and approach required in the report
fields.referenceAircraftIcao: Reference aircraft for the estimated time

progression.FlyAhead: Fly ahead without waiting for validation
progression.WaitForValidation: Wait for the previous leg to be validated

hubRotationOrder.Fixed: In the order of the tour

tourTemplates.title: Tour templates
tourTemplates.description: Ready-made settings a tour is born from: kind, limits, aircraft, briefing and pictures. Never dates, legs or hubs.

tourFromTemplate.description: The tour is born as a draft with the settings of the template; the dates are chosen afterwards.
tourFromTemplate.none: There are no tour templates yet.

tourSaveAsTemplate.description: The settings of this tour become a template: no dates, address or award.

aircraftProfiles.title: Aircraft profiles
aircraftProfiles.description: How fast each aircraft type flies: the speed the estimated time of a leg is computed with.

delete.title: Delete this profile?
delete.description: Tours with this type as reference aircraft stop showing an estimated time until a profile exists again.

aircraftGroups.title: Aircraft groups
aircraftGroups.description: Named sets of aircraft types, usable wherever a tour chooses its aircraft.

delete.title: Delete this group?
delete.description: Tours that allow this group no longer allow its types through it.

settings.title: Tour settings
settings.description: What the department changes without a release: limits, windows and the estimated time.
settings.toursInTheWay: These tours have no daily limit of their own: give them one before switching the division's off.

fields.rejectGraceHours: Hours of grace after a rejection
fields.leaseMinutes: Minutes a taken report stays with its validator
fields.durationFactor: Estimated time: share added to the distance (0.05 = 5%)
fields.retentionMonthsLong: Months the disciplinary record is kept
fields.thresholdToleranceMeters: Take-off distance allowed from the threshold (m)

errors.profileExists: This aircraft type already has a profile.
errors.retentionLongShorter: The disciplinary record cannot be kept for less time than the reports.
errors.countryCode: Write the country as its two letter code.
errors.closeBeforeRelease: The close has to come after the release.
errors.closeTooSoon: A ready tour closes at least two report windows from today, so that no pilot finds it closed under their feet.
errors.kindLocked: The kind no longer changes: the tour is already visible to the public.
errors.templateFixed: A tour does not become a template, nor a template a tour: use "Save as template" or "New from template".
errors.templateNeverReady: A template is not marked ready: a tour is created from it.
errors.releasedStaysReady: The tour has been released and does not go back to draft: it can be hidden.
errors.slugTaken: This address already belongs to another tour.
errors.dailyLimitRequired: The division's daily limit is off: the tour needs one of its own.
errors.referenceWithoutProfile: This aircraft has no profile: without its speed the estimated time cannot be computed.
errors.tourHasReports: This tour has reports and is not deleted: it can be hidden.
errors.toursNeedDailyLimit: Some tours still to be flown have no daily limit of their own.
